svg.text: 1. Carry over the evidence rules for TRL 1 to 6 and the phase cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Add the badge writer (RDK-DDR-003, change P5): it writes the TRL

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: badge line at the top of the README from the claimed TRL, so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the badge can no longer disagree with the project file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Add the decision-wording rule of R13: a decision written as

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: made with no owner and date fails (wording still open, O4).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: reads the reader's record (joint 1); the badge line and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PDF cover take the same TRL value (joint 3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a TRL claimed one level above its evidence fails; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: badge changes when, and only when, the TRL changes.
